name: AINumbers Fintech Intelligence Suite
description: 496+ browser-based fintech intelligence tools built by Post Oak Labs. Covers ISO 20022, A2A payments, open banking (CFPB §1033 / PSD3), EU AI Act, DORA, AML/KYC, BaaS, DLT/tokenization, Canton/tokenized market infrastructure (settlement capital, DvP atomicity, collateral mobility, digital asset classification), cross-border FX, real-time payments, e-invoicing (Peppol/ViDA), agentic payment protocols (AP2, ACP, x402, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay), and MCP developer tooling. All tools are client-side — zero PII, zero server calls.

execution_model.note: All tools execute in the user's browser via JavaScript. This MCP server is a reference/discovery server — agents should provide the tool URL and describe the inputs to the user, rather than attempting server-side execution. Pilot tools additionally support prefill deep-links (see capabilities.prefill_deep_links): agents may hand the user a one-click URL with inputs encoded in the hash fragment. A live MCP Apps server (SEP-1865) at https://mcp.ainumbers.co/mcp renders 7 flagship tools as interactive widgets in MCP Apps hosts (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, VS Code) and exposes a list_ainumbers_tools catalog-search tool for the rest.

prefill_deep_links.behavior: Fills tool inputs from the URL hash fragment (never transmitted to a server). Default is fill-only; '&run=1' opts into auto-execution. Synthetic/anonymised values only — zero-PII rules apply.
prefill_deep_links.coverage: All manifest-backed tools with bridge_version 1.0 (see catalog metadata.prefill).

policy_mandate_intake.behavior: Pilot tools accept an AINumbers Policy Mandate (.policy.json) via on-page drop/choose/paste; 'payload' and 'source_tool_inputs' are mapped onto matching inputs. Mandates are the interchange format between tools.
